data.short_meaning: Traditional Persian female name, historically borne by a ruler of Fars
data.long_meaning: Aabish (آبش) is a Persian female name recorded in the form Ābish. It is historically borne by Abish Khātūn, a thirteenth-century ruler of Fars whose capital was Shiraz. Its lexical sense is not securely established in standard Persian dictionaries, and baby-name sites give conflicting glosses, so no single lexical meaning is asserted here.

faq.q: What does the name Aabish mean?
faq.a: Aabish means Traditional Persian female name, historically borne by a ruler of Fars.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabish?
What language does the name Aabish come from?
faq.a: Aabish is used in Persian, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabish a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabish is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabish written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aabish is written آبش in Arabic and آبش in Urdu, and आबिश in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabish?
faq.a: The root of Aabish is Persian Ābish (آبش); lexical root uncertain.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabish?
faq.a: Persian personal name of uncertain lexical origin, historically associated with Abish Khātūn.

faq.q: Does Aabish appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic name. It is a Persian historical name used in Muslim communities.

faq.q: Is Aabish the same as the historical Abish Khātūn?
faq.a: Yes. The name is historically borne by Abish Khātūn, daughter of the atabeg Sa'd, who ruled Fars from Shiraz in the thirteenth century.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabish?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabish total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabish?
faq.a: Aabish appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Abish, Aabesh.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aabish?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aabish include Aabad, Aabroo.

faq.q: What is the lexical meaning of Aabish?
faq.a: The lexical sense is not securely established; sources give differing glosses. What is documented is its use as a Persian female name and its association with a medieval ruler of Fars.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabish used today?
faq.a: Aabish is used in Persian, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
